data.title: Binary Logic: Combinational Circuits
data.solution:
n=int(input())
defs=[input().split() for _ in range(n)]
q=input().strip()
a,b=map(int,input().split())
v={'A':a,'B':b}
for d in defs:
    name,op=d[0],d[1]
    if op=='BUFFER': v[name]=v[d[2]]
    elif op=='NOT': v[name]=1-v[d[2]]
    else:
        x,y=v[d[2]],v[d[3]]
        v[name]={'AND':x&y,'OR':x|y,'NAND':1-(x&y),'NOR':1-(x|y),'XOR':x^y,'XNOR':1-(x^y)}[op]
print(v[q])
data.statement:
A combinational circuit is built from logic gates connected by named wires.
Two input wires, A and B, carry the given input bits.
Each gate definition has the form: NAME OP SRC1 [SRC2], where the sources are A, B or the name of an earlier gate.
The gates are evaluated in the order they are given.
Finally, a query wire is named. Print the value carried by that wire.

Supported gates:
BUFFER (one source), NOT (one source), AND, OR, NAND, NOR, XOR, XNOR (two sources).
AND is 1 only when both inputs are 1; OR is 1 when at least one input is 1; NAND and NOR are their opposites; XOR is 1 when the inputs differ; XNOR is 1 when they are equal.

Goal

A combinational circuit is built from logic gates connected by named wires.
Two input wires, A and B, carry the given input bits.
Each gate definition has the form: NAME OP SRC1 [SRC2], where the sources are A, B or the name of an earlier gate.
The gates are evaluated in the order they are given.
Finally, a query wire is named. Print the value carried by that wire.

Supported gates:
BUFFER (one source), NOT (one source), AND, OR, NAND, NOR, XOR, XNOR (two sources).
AND is 1 only when both inputs are 1; OR is 1 when at least one input is 1; NAND and NOR are their opposites; XOR is 1 when the inputs differ; XNOR is 1 when they are equal.
Input
Line 1: The number of gate definitions N.
Next N lines: A gate definition NAME OP SRC1 [SRC2].
Next line: The query wire Q.
Next line: Two space-separated input bits A and B.
Output
Line 1: The bit carried by wire Q.
Constraints
1 <= N <= 16
Wire names are at most 8 characters
A, B are 0 or 1
